تستحسنون (form X)
# تَسْتَحْسِنُونَ (tastaḥsinūna) /tas.taħ.si.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْسَنَ (istaḥsana)
# تُسْتَحْسَنُونَ (tustaḥsanūna) /tus.taħ.sa.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْسَنَ (istaḥsana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
